_note: Hand corrections for the company data job. predecessorCik: older SEC registrants whose history should be merged in (ExxonMobil Holdings Corp took over the XOM listing in 2026; its history is under Exxon Mobil Corp). sharesOutstanding: for companies that don't tag their share count in XBRL, the count from the latest 10-Q cover page in listed-share equivalents (Berkshire: 488,450 Class A x 1,500 + 1,408,035,161 Class B, as of July 29, 2026). Update it when a new 10-Q comes out. shareClassFactor: listed shares per reporting share, if a company reports per-share figures in another class.

BRK.B.source: Berkshire Hathaway 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, cover page

debtTags._note: ticker: list of XBRL tags (namespace:Tag, us-gaap by default) whose values add up to total debt, for companies that report debt under their own tag names. data/co/_quality.json lists candidates after each refresh.

debtValue._note: Total debt from the filing itself, for companies whose debt is only tagged with dimensions or company-specific tags (which the SEC companyfacts feed leaves out). Update when a new 10-Q is filed.

F.source: Ford Q2 2026 results (8-K Exhibit 99), balance sheet: Company excluding Ford Credit debt, $4,381M payable within one year plus $19,238M long-term. Ford Credit’s $137.3B of debt funds its loans and is left with Ford Credit.

AES.source: AES 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, balance sheet: recourse debt $300M short-term and $5,800M long-term; non-recourse debt $3,162M short-term and $22,855M long-term.

financeArm._note: Companies whose consolidated figures include a large captive lending arm; a cash-flow model on the consolidated numbers does not value them properly, so the snapshot says so.
